description: This file defines a UI component named 'Header' for a furniture shopping frontend. It uses LightningJS to create the header with navigation buttons (Home and Cart), styling, and event handlers for user interaction.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the header bar with navigation buttons for a furniture shopping app.
